snippet.title: Turning Manor - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the demo release trailer for Turning Manor, a first person spot the difference anomaly memory game in the psychological horror genre. Play as a Quality Control Inspector who gets a weird job that sounds too good to be true. Strange things start happening as soon as you sign the contract... Can you unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor?

Play the Turning Manor demo now! On Steam or Itch.io:
* Steam - steampowered.com/app/4040700/Turning_Manor_Demo/
* Itch.io - sabbaticalgames.itch.io/turningmanor

#gaming #indiegame #horrorgaming
